KeyValet v0.2.1 is a patch release: it fixes a daemon-mode security bug in v0.2.0 (a gateway outlived its session), per-use approval prompts now summarize request bodies into business fields instead of raw previews, `keyvalet scan` imports are proxyable out of the box, the Codex hook adapter is rewritten to the official contract, and release binaries are notarized from this version on. The website is also rebuilt (bilingual, at https://keyvalet.dev).

## Highlights

- **Security fix: a gateway now ends with its session.** In v0.2.0's daemon mode, a gateway opened with `credential_gateway` kept running after its session was locked or closed: its token kept working, and the daemon kept that session's unlocked vault key in memory until the daemon restarted. A session now shuts its gateway down when it ends (tokens revoked, listener closed) and cancels its pending requests. If you opened gateways on v0.2.0, upgrade — or restart the daemon with `sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/dev.keyvalet.helper`.
- **Sessions right after a daemon restart no longer fail.** The daemon restarts the per-user agent on demand and the agent reconnects within 5 seconds, instead of reporting "agent not running" for up to 30 seconds.
- **Per-use prompts show business fields, not raw bodies.** When a grant is per-use, the helper now renders the request body for known APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Stripe, Slack, AWS) from a fixed root-side whitelist of fields — `model`, `amount`, `channel` and friends — instead of a raw 60-character preview. Secrets embedded in a body can no longer reach the Touch ID sheet; unknown hosts keep the old preview, and a body with nothing whitelisted shows only its size.
- **`keyvalet scan` imports ready-to-proxy credentials.** A hit whose type matches a service template is now stored with that template's injection rule and allowed hosts, as `proxy_only` — the migrated key works through `credential_http_request` immediately and its value is never returned to an agent. `keyvalet get` still prints it for you. Hits without a usable template keep the old plain import.
- **`keyvalet get` fix.** Static credentials created from a template store their secret in fields rather than `value`; `get` now prints the single field (or all fields as JSON) instead of nothing.
- **Codex hook adapter rewritten.** `kv-hook codex-tool` implements the official Codex `PreToolUse` contract: deny via `hookSpecificOutput` plus exit 2, never `ask` (Codex marks it failed and proceeds); `apply_patch` patch text and MCP calls are scanned, and KeyValet's own tools are exempt. The installer writes `~/.codex/hooks.json` with the new command and upgrades the file it wrote in v0.1/v0.2 automatically; Codex will ask you to trust the hook via `/hooks`.
- **Notarized releases.** From this version, release binaries are notarized by Apple in addition to the Developer ID signature; the release job fails if Gatekeeper rejects them.
- **New website.** https://keyvalet.dev is now a bilingual (en/zh-CN) site with guide, security digest, pricing and comparison pages — no JavaScript, no web fonts, strict CSP.

## Upgrade

```sh
curl -fsSL https://keyvalet.dev/install.sh | sh
```

## Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac (Intel Macs build from source; Secure Enclave on T2 Macs is untested)
- macOS 14 or later (tested on macOS 26.5.1)
- Touch ID or the macOS login password for approvals

## Known limitations

- Notarization is new in this release's workflow — flag anything Gatekeeper complains about.
- The Codex adapter implements the documented contract but has not been watched end-to-end in a live Codex session; trust it via `/hooks` and report if it doesn't fire.
- The passwordless `sudoers` rule is still installed for the fallback mode.

## 中文

KeyValet v0.2.1 是一个补丁版本：修复 v0.2.0 守护进程模式的一个安全问题（网关在会话结束后仍在运行），逐次授权弹窗改为把请求体摘要为业务字段而不是原始预览，`keyvalet scan` 导入的凭证开箱即可走代理，Codex hook 适配器按官方契约重写，并且本版本起发布二进制经过 Apple 公证。官网也已重建（双语，https://keyvalet.dev）。

### 亮点

- **安全修复：网关随会话一起结束。** 在 v0.2.0 的守护进程模式下，用 `credential_gateway` 开的网关在会话锁定或关闭后仍在运行：令牌照样能用，守护进程也一直把这个会话已解锁的凭证库密钥留在内存里，直到守护进程重启。现在会话结束时会关闭它的网关（撤销令牌、关闭监听），并取消还没完成的请求。如果你在 v0.2.0 上开过网关，请升级，或运行 `sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/dev.keyvalet.helper` 重启守护进程。
- **守护进程重启后，新会话不再失败。** 守护进程会按需重启用户代理，代理 5 秒内重连，不会再在最多 30 秒内报"用户代理未运行"。
- **逐次弹窗显示业务字段，而非原始请求体。** 逐次授权时，helper 对已知 API（OpenAI、Anthropic、GitHub、Stripe、Slack、AWS）按固定的 root 侧白名单渲染请求体——`model`、`amount`、`channel` 等——不再是原始 60 字符预览。藏在请求体里的秘密不会再出现在 Touch ID 弹窗；未知域名保留旧的预览，没有白名单字段的请求体只显示大小。
- **`keyvalet scan` 导入即可代理。** 命中服务模板的密钥现在会带上该模板的注入规则和域名白名单、以 `proxy_only` 存入——迁移进来的 key 立即可通过 `credential_http_request` 使用，其值永不返回给 agent。`keyvalet get` 仍能为你打印。没有可用模板的命中保持原来的普通导入。
- **`keyvalet get` 修复。** 模板创建的静态凭证把秘密存在字段里而非 `value`；`get` 现在会打印单个字段（或把多个字段按 JSON 打印），不再输出空白。
- **Codex hook 适配器重写。** `kv-hook codex-tool` 实现官方 Codex `PreToolUse` 契约：通过 `hookSpecificOutput` 加退出码 2 拒绝，绝不发 `ask`（Codex 会标记 hook 失败并放行）；`apply_patch` 的补丁文本和 MCP 调用都会被扫描，KeyValet 自己的工具豁免。安装器会用新命令写入 `~/.codex/hooks.json`，并自动升级 v0.1/v0.2 写过的旧文件；Codex 会要求你在 `/hooks` 里信任它。
- **发布已公证。** 本版本起，发布二进制在 Developer ID 签名之外再经 Apple 公证；Gatekeeper 拒绝则发布任务失败。
- **新官网。** https://keyvalet.dev 重建为双语（中英）站点，含使用指南、安全摘要、定价和对比页——无 JavaScript、无网络字体、严格 CSP。

### 升级

```sh
curl -fsSL https://keyvalet.dev/install.sh | sh
```

### 要求

- Apple Silicon Mac（Intel Mac 走源码构建；T2 Mac 上的 Secure Enclave 未测试）
- macOS 14 或更高版本（在 macOS 26.5.1 上测试）
- 批准需要 Touch ID 或 macOS 登录密码

### 已知限制

- 公证是本版本工作流新增的——Gatekeeper 若有任何告警请报告。
- Codex 适配器实现了文档契约，但尚未在真实 Codex 会话中完整验证；请在 `/hooks` 里信任后试用并反馈。
- 免密 `sudoers` 规则仍为回退模式保留。
